name: APEX
summary: APEX is based in Jefferson Lab Hall A, Newport News, Virginia. It is a dedicated dark-photon search using the existing Hall A spectrometers.
detection_principle: Electron bremsstrahlung produces weakly coupled vector particles; a high-resolution dual-arm spectrometer searches for narrow resonances in the measured e⁺e⁻ invariant mass.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
